test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

He was riding his bike on a __bumpy__ surface.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Steady**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bumpy **means having irregularities or rough surfaces. (अनियमितताएं या खुरदुरी सतह होना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The bumpy road made the journey uncomfortable.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Steady **means stable, constant, or without fluctuations. (स्थिर, निरंतर, या बिना उतार-चढ़ाव के)
 
 
• **Example**: *The athlete maintained a steady pace throughout the race.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jerky: **Characterized by sudden, abrupt movements. (धक्रका देनेवाला)
 
• **Uneven: **Not level or smooth; marked by irregularities. (असमतल)
 
• **Choppy: **Characterized by rough, turbulent, or irregular motion. (कठोर, अशांत, या अनियमित गति)
